entities.name: Q98PH2
observations: Exact full-length sequence match (360 aa) to reviewed Mycoplasmopsis pulmonis mannitol-1-phosphate 5-dehydrogenase; EC 1.1.1.17.
Catalyzes reversible interconversion of D-mannitol 1-phosphate and beta-D-fructose 6-phosphate coupled to NAD+/NADH.
Reference annotations include cytosol localization and mannitol catabolic process.

entities.name: RHEA:19661
observations: D-mannitol 1-phosphate + NAD(+) = beta-D-fructose 6-phosphate + NADH + H(+); EC 1.1.1.17, reversible.
